identity.feature: Boxy upright 60-series wagon: long flat bonnet, near-vertical side glass, flat roof with drip rails, long rear overhang
FJ62 face: quad rectangular headlamps in chrome bezels either side of a horizontal-bar grille with TOYOTA lettering, amber turn lamps below
Squared flared wheel arches, the front flare sweeping back to the door, with waist and lower creases along the flanks
Four doors plus rear quarter windows; split tailgate (lift glass over drop gate) with tall corner tail lamps
Chrome bumpers with black end caps, square chrome door mirrors, six-lug steel wheels
